projects.headline: Small moments. Whole new worlds.
projects.description: Our Roblox work brings the studio’s love of game development into a platform built around shared experiences. Explore this side of Thunder Buddies, or talk to us about building your own experience.

details.title: Built for play

projects.label: 02 / OPEN-SOURCE ARMA LIBRARY
projects.name:
OPEN BY
DESIGN.
projects.headline: Our Arma chapter. A resource for yours.
projects.description: OSAL is our public source library of Arma worlds, gameplay systems, vehicles, assets, and experiments. Browse the collection, explore the source, and carry the work forward under the library’s published license terms.

details.title: A shared foundation
details.text: Search the collection by name, description, or dependency, then explore source archives and project details.

details.title: A new studio chapter
details.text: Our current focus is Roblox, original games, platforms, and client projects. The library represents our earlier Arma work.

details.title: Keep the credit
details.text: Original studio work uses the library’s custom attribution license. Review the published terms; third-party work retains its own terms.

projects.name:
THUNDER
LINK.
projects.headline: A gaming platform with an independent spirit.
projects.description: Thunderlink is the studio’s own take on a gaming platform: a project that brings our game development background together with our experience building for the web. Step into the platform at thunderlink.online.

details.title: Beyond the game
details.text: Our work also lives around games: the places where players discover, connect, and spend time.

details.title: Studio-built
details.text: Thunderlink is part of the wider Thunder Buddies Studios portfolio of independent projects.

details.title: Explore the platform
details.text: Visit Thunderlink’s own website for its current features and availability.

projects.label: 04 / AN ORIGINAL TBS GAME
projects.name: FAULTLINE
projects.headline: Our own game. Our next chapter.
projects.description: Faultline is Thunder Buddies Studios’ original game. It’s a new chapter for our team: taking the experience we’ve built across other games and putting it into a world of our own.

details.title: Original IP
details.text: A game developed under our own identity, with the studio’s creative vision at its center.

details.title: Nine perspectives
details.text: One team bringing experience from different engines, projects, and player communities.

details.title: More to come
